verdict.rationale: Snowflake's own docs show in-product AI over user data. Cortex Analyst lets business users ask questions in natural language and get direct answers without SQL, Cortex AI Functions run LLM analytics on text and images, and CoWork is marketed as 'Ask anything.' This covers on-demand AI answers, but nothing documents proactive AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced to the user. Missing for 10: documented proactive insight/suggestion generation (not just Q&A answers), detail on how CoWork works in the product, and independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: With Cortex Analyst, business users can ask questions in natural language and receive direct answers without writing SQL.
Use Cortex AI Functions in Snowflake to run unstructured analytics on text and images with industry-leading LLMs from OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Mistral AI, and DeepSeek.
Bring agentic AI to all your data. Ask anything with Snowflake CoWork.
